content.title: Your Scent, Your Expression — edited EN
content.message: Two distinct fragrances can inspire personal exploration; no promised blended result.

shots.visual: On an ivory field, place the approved LAVISH OUD original image at 55% frame width without repainting the bottle or obscuring its label. Slow 2D push-in within safe crop; generous text margin in upper negative space. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.transition: Cut from black; fade in text over 180ms.

shots.visual: Editorial two-panel composition: approved LAVISH OUD image left, approved PERLA 50ML UNISEX image right. Introduce panels via restrained horizontal wipe; no visual implying actual mixing or test results. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: Balanced side-by-side composition of the two original product photos; use only 2D pan and cross-dissolve, respecting each original aspect ratio and legible packaging. Keep the visual exploratory, not instructional. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: Set approved square Lavish logo intact in its own square tile over a matte ivory backdrop, with unobstructed CTA beneath in readable type. Do not stretch or key out the opaque gold logo. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.transition: Hold final composition and fade to matte at exactly 15000ms.

content.caption: An editorial concept exploring personal scent expression with LAVISH OUD and PERLA 50ML UNISEX. No verified layering outcome is claimed. Concept POC / Mock. Explore Lavish Perfumes. No product-performance claim.
